basic_info.description: PREPAID PARKING for 5 years - 2 doors down. Transparent Pricing - Offers as they come Huge Condo - was originally 2 condos combined into one - Soaring Ceilings - Tons of upgrades - Experience the perfect blend of classic charm and modern convenience in this expansive 4-bedroom, 2-bath full-floor flat in the heart of North Beach. With soaring ceilings, rich hardwood floors, and elegant period details, this home offers warmth and sophistication in one of San Francisco's most beloved neighborhoods.    The thoughtfully designed single-level layout provides ample space for living, entertaining, and relaxing. The private primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat, featuring a spacious walk-in closet and a cozy sitting area. The chef's kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line Viking, Fisher & Paykel, and Bosch appliances, sleek granite countertops, and generous storage. A sunlit breakfast nook adds to its charm.    Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, a shared patio and garden, and extra storage. St. Peter and Paul Church and School are just steps from Washington Square Park, Joe DiMaggio Playground, and North Beach's best cafes and shops.
